- The session has no `add_repo` tool, so a run cannot attach the new repository itself. Only this MCP comment works (it follows the old name).

Do this:
1. In the cloud environment and each scheduled task of this project, change the GitHub repository to `lars-his-projects/travel-aggregator` (and install the Claude GitHub App on the `lars-his-projects` organization if it is not there).
2. Change the git remote of the environment to the new URL, if the environment sets it.
3. Start one run to check that `python3 framework/tools/cycle_start.py` exits 0.

Until then, each scheduled run stops with no work.
